name: AE TWA Unified, AEA Feed
description: AE TWA Unified, AEA Feed. Lossless fusion of ÆI (GAIA/ÆI seed) and ÆEA (MT4-parity market engine) as a Telegram Mini App. One ordered market feed advances both engines: the ÆEA bar ring (13 normalised indicators + Ichimoku → m/n/δ → regime → BB×58 → 𝒫_arc → signal iff δ-gate → orders/trailing/FVG) and the ÆI seed (prime → outward Λ₂₄ → Hopf → s²=r² → DbZ → I → SelfEvolution), with x lifted from the same tick as abs(price-prevPrice)/10000 (or 1/100 on zero). Backend authoritative. Frontend view only. No synthetic bars. Lattice [] equals WAITING, never 0. One formatter for app and bot. CS feed back / forward: Bot / TWA feeds CS, CS feeds Bot / TWA. Final, First edition.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram Bot Token from @BotFather. Set via Heroku config, never commit.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Telegram chat id for bot notifications.

TELEGRAM_WEBAPP_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the Telegram Mini App (Pages origin).

BACKEND_URL.description: Backend base URL. Set via Heroku config, never commit.

RELAY_URL.description: Cloudflare Worker relay URL (deployed from the aei-relay repo).

RELAY_KEY.description: Optional shared secret matching `wrangler secret put RELAY_KEY` in the aei-relay repo.

REQUIRE_AUTH.description: Enforce X-Telegram-Init-Data on all non-/health endpoints. Defaults to '1'.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Lock down writes to your Pages origin. Defaults to '*'.

SEED_TICK_INTERVAL.description: Seed loop interval in seconds. Defaults to '5'.

CRAWL_INTERVAL.description: Crawler loop interval in seconds. Defaults to '3'.

MAX_CRAWL_DEPTH.description: Maximum crawl recursion depth. Defaults to '3'.

LOG_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /log endpoint. Defaults to '1000'.

TOAST_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /toasts endpoint. Defaults to '500'.

ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs. Empty = open bot.
